text:
By R. R. Ellis ,
2 hours ago Loretta Lynn's MX Results 2026: Day 2 Top 5 Finishers From Wednesday Wednesday racing continued at Loretta Lynn’s Ranch as the 2026 AMA Amateur National Motocross Championship moved into another full day of motos in Hurricane Mills, Tennessee.
Day 2 featured a mix of opening motos for several divisions and returning classes building on their results from Tuesday.
Below are the top-five finishers from Wednesday’s scheduled races, organized by class in race order.
How To Watch Loretta Lynn's 2026 The 2026 Monster Energy AMA Amateur National Motocross Championship is streaming live on FloRacing, with coverage from Loretta Lynn’s Ranch featuring the top amateur motocross riders in the country.
Subscribe to FloRacing to watch Loretta Lynn’s and stay up to date with the latest motocross and motorsports coverage.

Why Is Loretta Lynn’s On A Subscription Service? The mission at FloSports is to grow our sports every day, and our model will work for amateur motocross by providing the direct investment, content and marketing needed to expand the sport’s reach.
A subscription model helps create a sustainable business that can support the growth of FloRacing, MX Sports and amateur motocross. At the same time, select motocross content and coverage will be available across social platforms and free distribution channels, including the FloRacing 24/7 channel through Prime Video, The Roku Channel, Fubo and YouTube.
We have created a mix of free and subscription-based access to give fans, families and the amateur motocross community different ways to follow the sport.
FloRacing Is The Streaming Home For Many Of Racing’s Top Events Each Year Don’t miss any of the exciting action, which can be enjoyed year-round at FloRacing. Check out the FloRacing schedule for more events.
